parsed.summary: The PR removes caching of string condition evaluation, which may introduce performance regressions and is not minimal.

issues.description: Removing caching may introduce performance regressions, as evaluating expressions repeatedly can be costly.
The change is not minimal, as it removes caching functionality that may have been added for a reason, even if not currently used.
